'''Media''' covering the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game includes print magazines, television commercials, Decipher advertising, and later video and audio shows.

Print features and inserts are catalogued at [[Magazines]]. Broadcast spots are at [[Television commercials]]. Fan websites are at [[Fan sites]]. Video channels, streams and podcasts are at [[Podcasts, video and interviews]]. Written and recorded interviews are at [[Interviews]]. Physical inserts, posters and print ads are also listed on [[SWCCG Memorabilia]].

== Magazines ==

Wizard Press's ''[[InQuest]]'', Krause's ''[[Scrye]]'', Wizards of the Coast's ''[[The Duelist]]'', TSR's ''[[Dragon (magazine)|Dragon]]'', Future Publishing's ''[[Arcane]]'' and Lucasfilm's ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' printed strategy, previews, decklists, tournament reports and promotional inserts during Decipher's run.<ref name="wp-swccg" /><ref name="enc183" /> [[Michael Mikaelian]] wrote InQuest's Killer Decks II list [[Michael Mikaelian Yavin 4 Counterstrike|Yavin 4 Counterstrike]] and the special report [[Star Wars World Championships (InQuest)]].<ref name="inquest20" /><ref name="inquest22" />

The dated catalog of sourced articles, mentions, ads and inserts is [[Magazines#Articles, mentions and inserts|Magazines]].

== Television commercials ==

Decipher advertised the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] on television in 1996. The surviving 31-second spot closes with the tagline "the galaxy in a box".<ref name="yt-tv" /> Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG TV Ad (1996) (transcript)]]. Catalog: [[Television commercials]].

== Video, podcasts and interviews ==

[[Radio Free Decipher]] was Decipher's weekly audio show from 4 December 1998. Later coverage moved to YouTube, Twitch and interview podcasts; see [[Podcasts, video and interviews]] and [[Interviews]].
